header.title: Account
header.description: Your password and how you sign in. Each change is recorded in the audit log.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: Other browsers and devices are signed out when it changes.
password.changed: You're still signed in here; other sessions were signed out.

required.title: Choose your own password to continue
required.body: An administrator set the password you signed in with. Replace it with one only you know; the rest of Ronne opens once you have. Use the password you signed in with as the current one.

errors.too_short: The new password needs at least 12 characters
errors.too_long: The new password can have at most 128 characters
errors.same_password: The new password must be different from the one you signed in with
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts, wait a minute

password.changedToast: Password changed. You're still signed in here; other sessions were signed out.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Everything this instance holds about you in one JSON file: your account, sessions, token names, workspaces, items, submissions, comments and audit events. It isn't a backup, and other people's data isn't in it. You can download it once every 10 minutes. A list over 10,000 rows is cut, and the file says so at the top; ask root for a database export if you need more.

language.title: Language
language.description: Ronne's screens come in English, Portuguese and French. This changes the screens, not what people publish: item names, descriptions and files stay as their authors wrote them, and rmk stays in English.
language.label: Language of the screens
language.hint: Automatic follows your browser, and English when it asks for another language.
language.saved: The screens now use the language you chose.
language.savedAutomatic: The screens now follow your browser's language.
language.invalid: Choose one of the languages in the list.
language.notOffered: Your earlier choice, {name}, isn't offered on this instance now, so Automatic applies. It comes back if root offers it again.

required.title: Set up two-factor sign-in to continue
required.body: Your administrator requires it for {who, select, reviewers {root and the moderators and admins of shared workspaces} other {everyone}}. The rest of Ronne opens once it's on.

continue.title: Two-factor sign-in is on
continue.body: You can go back to what you were doing.

panel.title: Two-factor sign-in
panel.companyTitle: Your company's sign-in protects your account
panel.company: You sign in through your company's identity provider, which asks for its own second step. There's nothing to set up here.
panel.offIntro: Signing in will also ask for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone, so a stolen password isn't enough.
panel.onIntro: Signing in with your password also asks for a code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
panel.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# backup code left.} other {# backup codes left.}}

setup.done: From now on, signing in with your password also asks for a code from the app.
setup.step1: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator…).
setup.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the key.
setup.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.startOverSummary: Start over with a new key
setup.startOverNote: A new QR code and new backup codes; this one stops working.

manage.regenerateNote: Ten new codes, shown once. The ones you have now stop working.
manage.off: Signing in asks only for your password now.
manage.code: A code from the app, or a backup code

backup.fileTitle: Ronne AI Marketplace: two-factor backup codes
backup.fileAbout: Each code works once, in place of a code from your authenticator app.
backup.title: Backup codes
backup.save: They won't be shown again. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone.

errors.not_signed_in: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.no_password: Your account has no password here: you sign in through your company, which protects the sign-in.
errors.wrong_code: That code is wrong. Check the phone's clock if it keeps failing.
errors.used: That code was already used. Wait for the next one from the app.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts, wait a minute
errors.another_tab: Enrolment was started in another tab. Start again.
errors.replaced: This setup was replaced by a newer one, in another tab or by a second click. Start again.
errors.just_made: You just made new backup codes: use those.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Personal tokens for rmk and the MCP server. They act as you; they can't sign in to this website.
tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Create one, or run rmk login.
tokens.name: Name

create.title: Create access token
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Where you'll use it, for example the machine or the CI job.
create.confirm: I understand this token works until I revoke it.
create.mustConfirm: Tick the box to confirm a token that never expires.

created_panel.copyBody: It won't be shown again. Anyone with it can act as you until it expires or you revoke it.

revoke.title: Revoke access token
revoke.body: Revoke {name}? Anything using it, such as rmk on that machine, stops working and has to sign in again.
revoke.revoked: Revoked. It stops working on its next request.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Bring the Getting started checklist back on Home. It picks up where you are: what you’ve done stays ticked.
